title: The Active Court
learning_focus: Striking/fielding and net/wall game concepts; agility, balance, coordination, fair play, and active living.
story_premise: The park’s final court cannot open because its game stations reward only speed. The player redesigns them for skill, safety, teamwork, and participation.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Striking/fielding and net/wall game concepts; agility, balance, coordination, fair play, and active living.

areas.title: Ready Stance Yard
areas.story: Practice balance and safe body position. Move through change-of-direction patterns at an adjustable pace.

opening_dialogue.text: A health or safety concern is affecting Ready Stance Yard.

opening_dialogue.text: Practice balance and safe body position.
